name: v0
description: v0 MCP is Vercel's official MCP server for its AI app builder. Import designs, start and manage chats, send prompts, and get live previews of generated apps—all in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add v0 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add v0 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://v0.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the v0 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: v0 provides these MCP tools: createChat, getChat, getPreview, import-claude-design-from-url, listChats, listMessages, resolveTask, and sendChatMessage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to v0?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to v0 in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
v0 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
v0 is developed by Vercel. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
